question: Does the corrected internal null (cross-attention minus matched token concatenation donor balanced accuracy) persist when the arbitrary chromosome-name lexicographic tie-break inside prevalence ties is replaced by a fixed sha256 ordering, holding the candidate construction, prevalence definition, region budget, splits, normalization, model families and primary statistic fixed?
prospective_relative_to: This amendment is prospective only for this new sensitivity. The historical prevalence-then-lexicographic rule and its already-known outcomes are historical and are preserved unchanged.

selection_change.only_factor_changed: the tie-break applied within equal training-library prevalence
selection_change.historical_rule: top-256 exact intervals by training-library prevalence; ties broken by (chromosome, start, end)
selection_change.new_rule: top-256 exact intervals by training-library prevalence; ties broken by the fixed sha256 ordering below, then the region string
unchanged: prevalence definition (number of that fold's training libraries containing the exact interval)
chromosome filter (none; noncanonical contigs retained if the historical rule included them)
candidate construction (exact-interval union of training-library Peaks rows; no merge or projection)
outer folds and donor splits (5 repeats x 5 donor-held-out folds, split_seed=0)
no disease-label or held-out-donor information enters selection
explicitly_not_done: no salt search or selection among salts after seeing performance
no chromosome-21 enrichment or chromosome balancing using disease effects
no claim that the hash-tied set is genome-wide coverage or a validated regulatory panel

discovery_scope.declared: historical outer-training discovery scope for direct comparability
discovery_scope.includes: the outer-training donors' libraries, whose per-library peak lists also cover inner-validation donors' unlabelled peaks
discovery_scope.variance_selection_scaling_fitting: RNA/ATAC variance selection, scaling and any label-dependent fitting remain on inner-training donors only, unchanged from the corrected protocol
discovery_scope.stricter_protocol: If a stricter inner-training-only discovery is required for a later confirmatory analysis it must be specified as a separate experiment; it is not silently bundled here.

inputs_and_hashes.features_dir: reports/generated/repeated_comparison_20260921/features/ (37 cached GSE305146 per-library features files; per-file sha256 in configs/repeated_region_sets_2026-09-21.json library_provenance)
inputs_and_hashes.count_unit: unique_fragment_overlap (one count per unique qualifying fragment record)

unchanged_execution_protocol.source: saved corrected run (docs/repeated_internal_comparison_corrected_2026-09-21.json), not stale historical labels
unchanged_execution_protocol.primary_contrast: cross_attention minus token_concat donor balanced accuracy
unchanged_execution_protocol.primary_statistic: pool held-out donor predictions within each repeat, compute donor balanced-accuracy contrast, average repeats, donor-cluster bootstrap 1000 draws seed 22
unchanged_execution_protocol.invalid_bootstrap_draws: single-class draws remain failures, not redraws

planned_diagnostics: deterministic per-fold region sets, ordered union BED, region/union hashes
per-fold and union chromosome distributions for historical vs hash-tie sets
overlap of hash-tie regions with the historical per-fold regions and union
training-library prevalence summaries for both sets
regression checks: deterministic ranking under shuffled input order; no outer-test library in discovery; preserved prevalence priority; historical-mode byte reproduction
measured nonzero support and count distributions by donor and author cell type for historical and new panels
six-family comparison plus majority control and the missing simple linear controls on both representations

success_and_stop_criteria.selection_valid_if: the hash-tie rule is deterministic, retains prevalence priority, uses no held-out or label information, and the historical rule reproduces its saved artifacts exactly
success_and_stop_criteria.experiment_completes_when: the corrected protocol is executed once on the hash-tie representation with the six families, majority control, simple linear controls, five initialization seeds and interventions, and the primary contrast and interval are reported side by side with the historical corrected null
success_and_stop_criteria.positive_result: exploratory and requires independent confirmation; it does not establish a cross-attention advantage
success_and_stop_criteria.null_result: acceptable and completes the experiment when execution is valid
success_and_stop_criteria.stop_rule: do not modify features or models to escape a null; do not choose among salts or rerun for a desired result

claim_boundaries: removing lexicographic preference within prevalence ties is not genome-wide coverage or a validated regulatory panel
the hash-tie set is not an outcome-driven improvement and was not selected using disease effects
external validation remains separately gated and is not affected by this local representation experiment
